```{r}
#| label: setup
#| cache: false

source(here("helper", "plot_settings.R"))

# p-value formatter
fmt_p <- function(p) if (p < .001) "< .001" else paste0("= ", sub("^0", "", round(p, 3)))

# convert multiplicative factor to percentage increase/decrease
mult_to_pct <- \(x, more, less) {
  if_else(x > 1,
          glue("{round((x - 1) * 100, 1)}% {more}"),
          glue("{round((1 - x) * 100, 1)}% {less}"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: site-info

site_labels <- c("uniandes-co-bogota" = "pilot_uniandes_co_bogota",
                 "uniandes-co-rural" = "pilot_uniandes_co_rural",
                 "mpieva-de" = "pilot_mpieva_de_main",
                 "western-ca" = "pilot_western_ca_main")

site_pal <- ptol_pal()(length(site_labels)) |>
  rlang::set_names(names(site_labels))
.scale_colour_site <- \(...) scale_colour_manual(values = site_pal, ...)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data

# run data
run_data <- read_rds(here("data/runs_mrot.rds"))

# RT data
task_data <- read_rds(here("data/task_data_nested.rds"))

# IRT data
mrot_scores <- read_rds(here("models/mrot_scores.rds")) |>
  filter(model_set == "multigroup_dataset") # also contains "multigroup_site"

# coefficients
mrot_coefs <- read_rds(here("models/mrot_coef.rds")) |>
  filter(model_set == "multigroup_dataset") # also contains "multigroup_site"

# sex info for sex differences analyses
sex_data_cleaned <- read_rds(here("data/sex_data_cleaned.rds"))
```

```{r}
#| label: filter-runs

# apply filters to runs for use in all subsequent analyses
min_trials <- 10
min_gap_months <- 3
run_data_filtered <- run_data |>
  filter(num_attempted >= min_trials) |>
  filter(!is.na(age), age >= 5, age <= 14) |>
  arrange(user_id, age) |>
  group_by(user_id) |>
  mutate(run_number = row_number(),
         age_gap = age - lag(age)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter_out(age_gap < min_gap_months / 12) |>
  select(site, dataset, user_id, run_id, age, adaptive)

# create age groups based on roughly equal sample sizes
ages <- run_data_filtered |> pull(age)
age_breaks <- c(5, 8, 11, 14)

# add age groups and site labels
runs_filtered <- run_data_filtered |>
  mutate(age_group = cut(age, breaks = age_breaks,
                         include.lowest = FALSE, right = FALSE),
         site_label = dataset |>
           recode_values(from = site_labels, to = names(site_labels)))
```

```{r}
#| label: sample-counts

# overall
site_n_df <- run_data |>
  group_by(dataset) |>
  summarise(n_users = n_distinct(user_id),
            n_runs = n_distinct(run_id)) |>
  mutate(site_label = dataset |>
           recode_values(from = site_labels, to = names(site_labels)))

site_n <- site_n_df |> nest(ns = -site_label) |> deframe()

mrot_df <- mrot_scores |> inner_join(runs_filtered)

n_excluded <- mrot_scores |>
  anti_join(mrot_df) |>
  summarise(n_users = n_distinct(user_id),
            n_runs = n_distinct(run_id))

n_final <- mrot_df |>
  summarise(n_users = n_distinct(user_id),
            n_runs = n_distinct(run_id))

n_repeat_users <- runs_filtered |>
  group_by(user_id) |>
  summarise(n_assessments = n_distinct(run_id)) |>
  filter(n_assessments > 1) |>
  nrow()
```

```{r}
#| label: trial-level-rts

mrot_trials <- task_data |>
  select(data) |>
  unnest(data) |>
  inner_join(runs_filtered)

mrot_rt_trial <- mrot_trials |>
  select(site_label, user_id, run_id, adaptive,
         age, age_group, trial_id, trial_number, item_uid, item_group, item,
         item_original, correct, rt_numeric) |>
  mutate(
    correct    = as.integer(correct),
    rt_s       = as.numeric(rt_numeric) / 1000,
    log_rt     = log(rt_s),
    angle      = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(item, "(?<=_)\\d+")),
    angle_full = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(item_original, "\\d{3}$")),
    stimulus   = str_extract(item, "^[a-z]+")
  ) |>
  filter(is.finite(rt_s), rt_s > 0)
```

```{r}
#| label: sex-data-coverage

mrot_trial_sex <- mrot_rt_trial |>
  left_join(sex_data_cleaned) |>
  distinct(user_id, site_label, sex)

site_sex_counts <- mrot_trial_sex |>
  count(site_label, sex) |>
  mutate(sex = sex |> replace_na("Unknown")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = n)

overall_sex_counts <- mrot_trial_sex |>
  count(sex) |>
  mutate(sex = sex |> replace_na("Unknown")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = n)
```

```{r}
#| label: site-timespans

site_spans <- mrot_trials |>
  group_by(site_label) |>
  summarise(earliest = min(timestamp),
            latest = max(timestamp)) |>
  mutate(across(-site_label, as_date)) |>
  nest(range = -site_label) |>
  deframe()
```

```{r}
#| label: cat-exclusion-counts

cat_counts <- mrot_rt_trial |>
  group_by(adaptive) |>
  summarise(trials = n(), runs = n_distinct(run_id)) |>
  mutate(adaptive = if_else(adaptive, "n_cat", "n_non_cat")) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(trials, runs), names_to = "count") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = adaptive, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(n_total = n_cat + n_non_cat,
         pct_cat = round(n_cat / n_total * 100, 1)) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(across(where(is.integer), \(x) format(x, big.mark = ","))) |>
  nest(counts = -count) |>
  deframe()
```

```{r}
#| label: site-info-tbl

trials_per_run <- mrot_rt_trial |>
  group_by(site_label, user_id, run_id) |>
  summarise(n_trials = n()) |>
  group_by(site_label) |>
  summarise(
    trials_mean = mean(n_trials),
    trials_sd   = sd(n_trials),
    trials_min  = min(n_trials),
    trials_max  = max(n_trials),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(trials_summary = sprintf("%.0f (%.1f) [%d–%d]", trials_mean, trials_sd,
                                  trials_min, trials_max)) |>
  select(site_label, trials_summary)

site_features <- tribble(
  ~site_label, ~area, ~testing_location, ~testing_setting, ~testing_device,
  "mpieva-de", "Leipzig, Germany", "home", "individual", "family device",
  "uniandes-co-bogota", "Bogotá, Colombia", "school", "group", "researcher-provided tablet",
  "uniandes-co-rural", "Caquetá & Boyacá, Colombia", "school", "group", "researcher-provided tablet",
  "western-ca", "London, Ontario, Canada", "lab", "individual", "researcher-provided tablet"
)

site_info <- mrot_df |>
  group_by(site_label) |>
  summarise(
    n_run    = n(),
    n_user   = n_distinct(user_id),
    age_mean = mean(age),
    age_sd   = sd(age),
    age_min  = min(age),
    age_max  = max(age),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(age_summary = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f) [%.1f–%.1f]",
                               age_mean, age_sd, age_min, age_max)) |>
  left_join(trials_per_run) |>
  left_join(site_features) |>
  select(site_label, area, n_run, n_user, age_summary, trials_summary, testing_location, testing_setting, testing_device)
  # mutate(testing_format = glue("Location: {location}\\newline Setting: {setting}\\newline Device: {device}") |> as.character()) |>
  # select(site_label, area, n_run, n_user, age_summary, trials_summary, testing_format)
```
